name: Jinchengjiang
source: Jinchengjiang District government portal and Guangxi/Hechi natural-resources materials evidence the local and higher-level custodians of real-estate registration and geospatial work, but no public anonymous parcel feature service was verified.

queries.query: Jinchengjiang China official cadastral map parcel GIS Natural Resources Bureau
queries.result: Search found no Jinchengjiang-specific anonymous cadastral parcel API or downloadable parcel dataset. It did identify official Guangxi natural-resources reporting about Hechi real-estate registration work in Jinchengjiang and the national real-estate registration center portal.

queries.query: 河池市 金城江区 自然资源局 不动产登记 地籍图 公共服务 地图
queries.result: 发现官方金城江区政府门户及其政务地图页面；页面列出河池市金城江区自然资源局、地址和电话。发现广西政务服务入口，但未发现可匿名返回宗地稳定ID与完整几何的接口；相关不动产登记查询通常进入政务服务/登录流程。

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official district portal; navigation exposes government information, public services and a government-map page. No parcel geometry endpoint was present in the fetched homepage.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Jinchengjiang District People's Government public government map
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Current page lists 河池市金城江区自然资源局 (Jinchengjiang District Natural Resources Bureau) at 南新西路128号 with consultation phone 0778-2283677. The page is a points-of-interest map and contains no cadastral parcel layer or parcel API.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Guangxi Department of Natural Resources / Hechi Natural Resources Bureau
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official Guangxi report describes Hechi Natural Resources Bureau conducting real-estate registration problem resolution in Jinchengjiang; it is custodian evidence, not a parcel data service.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Guangxi government service portal / Jinchengjiang district service site
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Reachable service catalog names the district Natural Resources Bureau. The inspected page does not expose a public parcel feature response; no login or credential flow was attempted.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official district homepage fetched. No cadastral parcel service or geometry was present in the response.

Current government-map HTML and JavaScript inspected. It uses TianDiTu map display for office points and lists the local Natural Resources Bureau; no parcel layer, schema, CRS, or parcel geometry response was exposed.
District government-service catalog fetched and inspected; Natural Resources Bureau entry present, but no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry endpoint was exposed.
Guangxi e-government portal fetched; page contains login-oriented service navigation and no parcel feature response. No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA or challenge bypass was attempted.
National geographic-resource catalog route was not usable anonymously; no challenge bypass was attempted and no parcel request was made.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: National real-estate registration center lead could not be fetched directly; search evidence was retained only as a relevant national lead, not as a parcel source.

coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: Local natural-resources and real-estate-registration custodian is evidenced, but public registry parcel-data access is not evidenced.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native ID if later exposed
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: No parcel attributes were requested or retained; no owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were accessed.

blocker: No anonymous public parcel ID-plus-geometry response or downloadable cadastral dataset was verified. Serial review must independently qualify any later public source, including stable native identity, CRS/axis handling, coverage and legal/source semantics.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [24.6965389868011,108.062645597383] preserved in latitude/longitude order; it was not shifted and no exact-point hit or miss was treated as citywide evidence.
No sample GeoJSON retained because no safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained.
A map extent miss, TLS failure, WAF response, timeout, login-oriented portal, or absent service listing is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No login, credentials, private token use, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
Packet completion is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
identityPolicy: No GeoJSON was retained. If a future source is qualified, retain exactly one stable native parcel identity as properties.id and keep source field mapping in metadata.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently inspect any authenticated-free official Jinchengjiang, Hechi or Guangxi parcel service that becomes available, verify native IDs, CRS/axis handling and coverage, and keep runtime held until qualification.
